experiment_name: Post-hoc decision-critical audit of 021's TEST predictions: segment analysis and a final A/B call

algorithm_config.method: 021's exact deterministic pipeline (same seeds/split/quantile-sampling/ValueProbe training, imported directly from probe_v1/probe_v2, not redefined) re-derived once to recover per-state fields 021 never persisted (legal-action count, decision phase). Reconciled against 021's own logged TEST metrics before drawing any conclusion.
algorithm_config.diagnostic_only: all segment-level breakdowns - no CI/p-value computed per segment; 021's game-block bootstrap remains the one confirmatory statistic
algorithm_config.decision_rule: Recommend B (propose new value hypothesis) only if >=1 segment has >=20 states AND learned ValueProbe top-1 accuracy exceeds the probabilistic leader's by >=5 percentage points; otherwise A (drop learned-value path). Rule fixed in source before running.

segment_legal_action_count_condensed.note: 186 distinct raw legal_action_count values in the full audit (mostly distinct auction bid amounts) - condensed here into 3 ranges for readability; full per-value breakdown is in raw_logs

result: 021's 96-game POLICY_ONLY pipeline was re-derived deterministically (same seeds/config, same ValueProbe training recipe, zero new randomness) and its four TEST-set predictor summaries (uniform, hard leader, probabilistic leader, learned ValueProbe) reconciled EXACTLY against 021's own logged values (all deltas 0.0) - confirming this audit genuinely analyzes 021's data, not new data, before any conclusion was drawn. Segment analysis across round bucket, probabilistic-leader margin quartile, current-player rank, decision type, and legal-action count found NO segment where the learned ValueProbe meaningfully beat the probabilistic net-worth-leader baseline: value_probe_advantage_segments_found is empty against the pre-stated bar (>=20 states, >=5-point accuracy margin, fixed before running). The leader dominates almost everywhere - 100.0% accuracy in every round bucket from round 26 onward, every margin quartile except Q1, every current-player-rank group (94.9%-98.3%), and every decision-type/legal-action-count regime (87.9%-99.3%) - while the learned ValueProbe stays in the 35-77% range across every one of the same segments, never approaching the leader. The 26 TEST states (3.4% of 759) where the leader itself was wrong concentrate ENTIRELY in round bucket 1-25 and margin quartile Q1(low margin) (100% of wrong-leader states in both, by construction/definition of margin correlating with correctness) - i.e. the leader is only ever fallible in the earliest, most net-worth-undifferentiated part of the game, and even there is right 86.2% of the time. Per the pre-stated decision rule, the final call is A: drop the learned-value path for now and move to the decision/policy win-rate phase. No claim is made about POLICY_ONLY/PUCT/MonopolyZeroNet strength; no win-rate evaluation, no PUCT, and no new/different model were run.
notes: The raw stdout log's segment_reports.legal_action_count has 186 distinct raw values (mostly individual auction bid-dollar-amounts, an artifact of ppo-plus-v2's action space rather than a meaningful small-cardinality decision-type signal) - condensed into 3 ranges in this log's metrics for readability; the full per-value breakdown (mostly count=1 or count=2 per value) is preserved in the raw stdout, not lost. margin_quartile and current_player_rank are explicitly OUTCOME-ADJACENT axes (both derived from the same net-worth signal the probabilistic leader baseline is itself scored on) - their clean-looking accuracy-vs-segment relationships are partly definitional (of course a low-margin/behind-in-net-worth state is harder to call correctly), not fresh generalization evidence; round_bucket, decision_type, and legal_action_count are comparatively less circular (game-time/state-structure features, not derived from the prediction being scored) but still diagnostic/exploratory only, not a confirmatory test. All segment-level accuracy/CE/Brier numbers in this log are point estimates with no per-segment CI - 021's game_block_bootstrap_learned_vs_probabilistic_leader result remains the only confirmatory statistic this project stands behind for the overall learned-vs-leader comparison.
